# Templates

One template per docs artifact type. Templates are named by type, not
numbered, since they are a fixed set, not a sequence.

- [decision.md](decision.md): decision records in docs/decisions/.
- [proposal.md](proposal.md): design proposals in docs/proposals/.
- [research.md](research.md): research notes in docs/research/.
- [ticket.md](ticket.md): implementation tickets in docs/issues/.
- [story.md](story.md): end-to-end user stories in docs/stories/.

Shared rules: files are `NNN-kebab-name.md`, every folder has a README.md
index with one line per file, headers come before prose, and prose stays
short. If a section has nothing to say, delete the section.
